chunks: Sa'd narrated from Muhammad ibn 'Isa from Yunus from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar and others, who said:
I asked him about Fitrah (Zakat al-Fitr). He said, "When you set it aside, it does not harm you when you give it, whether before the prayer or after the prayer."

key_terms.الْفِطْرَة: Zakat al-Fitr, the alms-tax given at the end of Ramadan
key_terms.عَزَلْتَهَا: You set it aside / designate it

ai.seo_question: When should Zakat al-Fitr be paid relative to the Eid prayer?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the validity of Zakat al-Fitr is not contingent upon the precise moment of disbursement, provided the obligation has been fulfilled and the amount set aside. This ruling alleviates anxiety regarding the exact timing, affirming that giving it before or after the Eid prayer is equally acceptable, thereby emphasizing the ease (*taysir*) intended by the Shariah in this act of purification.
